name: Imposter Mech
clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of a creature an opponent controls, except it's a Vehicle artifact with crew 3 and it loses all other card types.

needs.proposedSignature: `COVER_RULES.asEnters.lines` gains `^you may have ~ enter as a copy of (.+?)(?:, except .+?)?\.?$`, satisfied by an `asEnters` entry of kind `enter-as-copy` (value check: `optional === true` plus the entry's `filter` / `who`); and `enter-as-copy.who` gains `'opponent'` for "a creature an opponent controls"
needs.semantics: The clone as-enters exists and works, but there is no way to CLAIM the line it implements: `covers[].by` has no kind for it (the `asEnters` kind's anchored shapes are all the tapped / counters / choose forms), and a replacement effect is not an ability, so no ability may claim it either. Every clone card therefore comes out `scripted` with a correct declaration and one permanently unclaimed line — Vizier of Many Faces (55bceb83) hit this in wave 10.0 and Auton Soldier hits it here with round trip 1.00. Separately, `who` is only 'you' | 'any', so Imposter Mech's "a creature an OPPONENT controls" cannot be declared at all without making the card strictly better than printed.
needs.clause: You may have ~ enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it isn't legendary, is an artifact in addition to its other types, and has myriad. / You may have ~ enter as a copy of a creature an opponent controls, except it's a Vehicle artifact with crew 3 and it loses all other card types.
